_doc: Render massing for Athena campus Pottelberg (Pottelberg 4, secondary school; Nominatim name, not in our OSM extract), read by pipeline/src/scene.ts. GRB 1746889 (the U of wings) rendered as one flat 26.85 m block with orange walls (3D GRB HN_P99 is the highest ridge). Metres in Lambert 72 around 'anchor' (vertex mean), u along 'axis_deg' -51.5 (u south-east, v north-east). DHMV II: wings ~10 m wide with pitched roofs: west wing ridge 21.5 m along v at u -59 (eaves ~17.5 m), north wing west half ridge 27 m along u at v 38-40 (eaves ~20 m), north wing east half ridge 17.5 m (eaves 14.5 m), east wing ridge 23 m at u 49-51 (eaves ~17 m), its north end lower. Look (orthophoto in refs/: red tile roofs; wall colour not checked, Street View was not available): red tiled pitched roofs on brick wings around a courtyard.

parts.id: wings up to the lowest eave (GRB footprint)
